name: Shared Meal Plans
description: Meals planned for dates, eaters, portions, and recipe references. Uses an existing Collaboration space and its membership.
captureExamples: Let's have the lentil soup on Tuesday.
notes: This is a concrete standard extension, generated from Meal Plans authoring source. Record payload schema identities are shared; membership comes only from the existing Collaboration space.
Use this variant when the user has selected a shared space. Standalone Meal Plans remains appropriate for independently shared roots. Do not write the same fact into both variants.

Admin and editor powers are explicitly declared per path. The owner controls space membership and subtree pruning. Personal root-level state is excluded from the shared subtree; keep it in the user's own module.

capture.identity: Select the existing Collaboration space first. Match the selected plan, date and meal slot.
exclude: Writing the same fact to both the standalone and shared variant. An eating observation or pantry stock change.
capture.workflow: Plan meals and link recipes; record consumption in Food Diary and shopping intent in Groceries. Membership comes from the selected space; keep personal state outside the shared subtree.
